non_regression_margins.derivation: v_{t+1}=(1-dt*d_eff)v_t+dt*a; d_eff in [d*0.95, d] (the declared warm-start coupling), a in [0, STRIDE_GAIN*stride_amp_hi=0.99]; envelope V = a_max/d_lo = 0.99/(0.35*0.95) = 2.977443609022557 m/s (contraction fixed point); build N+1 scales every d_eff by 1.01, so Delta_{t+1} = (1-dt*d'_t)Delta_t - dt*0.01*d_t*v_t and the geometric sum over ANY horizon gives max|Delta_v| <= delta*V/(1.01*0.95) = 0.01*2.977443609022557/0.9595 = 0.03103119967715015 m/s

refusal_rationale: The harness REFUSES action-replay input by construction (no input channel accepts a pre-recorded action stream; attempts raise ACTION_REPLAY_REFUSED). WHY: replaying build-N actions into build N+1 tests the OLD trajectory, not the coupled system -- the failure mode the gate exists to catch is what the new physics' RESPONSES do to the loop; an action-replay would certify noise and structurally cannot see the feedback divergence it must detect. Observations and actions are therefore recomputed from the NEW trajectory at every tick.
